For credentials where `userId` is `null` (e.g., team-owned credentials), it will always fall back to calling the provider refresh function directly, meaning the new “credential sync” behavior is not applied to those installs. The diff does not show `createOAuthAppCredential`’s internal logic or any `state.teamId` behavior, so that part of the finding is not verifiable from the provided changes.
